events.summary: 阿拉里克召塔拉辛到自己的私人餐厅共进午餐，两人隔着长桌对坐，各怀心事。
events.quote: They were seated at opposite ends of the table in his private dining room, the distance between them spanned by bowls of rice noodles and fish cakes in broth

events.summary: 阿拉里克解释马哈吉尔憩地（Mahagir’s Rest）已不再不可侵犯，他父亲在那里设了据点，扩建是为船员及家眷改善居住、不再依赖内陆补给。
events.quote: “Mahagir’s Rest is no longer inviolate,” said Alaric. “My father already installed a base there. More development would mean improved housing for the crew and their families

events.summary: 阿拉里克指责塔拉辛在议会上公开与他争辩、质疑他筹划数月的法案，是直接违背加冕时立下的服从誓言。
events.quote: By arguing with me in public—by questioning prospective laws that I have spent months working on—you are in direct violation of those vows.

events.summary: 阿拉里克提出折中办法：她可以把反对意见与替代方案正式书面提出，他会研究，若认可便替她推动，以免军官们以为他在拆夜帝国的台。
events.quote: “Make all the counterproposals and objections that you wish and I shall study them. Make everything formal and aboveboard

events.summary: 塔拉辛推开盘子起身离席，阿拉里克追出餐厅；她快步走进他的书房，他抢在门关上之前用身体卡住门缝。
events.quote: The guards stationed in the hallway gave a start as the Night Empress stormed past them, the Night Emperor hot on her heels.

events.summary: 阿拉里克发现她手上没戴婚戒，抓住她的手腕逼问戒指下落，并要求她把戒指交出来修好、重新戴上。
events.quote: “For starters,” Alaric said tersely, “you can hand over your ring so I can have it fixed. And then you can put it back on.”

events.summary: 阿拉里克把她的手按在自己胸口，宣称她得再给他五十年、他不会放她走；随后他低头吻她，两人在他的书桌上发生关系。
events.quote: She opened her mouth for him at once and he was lost, dipped in gold. She tasted of peaches, her tongue caressing his like summer-bright silk.

events.summary: 性事结束后，塔拉辛窝在他耳边，放任自己幻想他索要的那五十年，同时清楚自己不可能拥有。
events.quote: She nuzzled at his ear and gave in to yet another moment of weakness, allowing herself to dream about those fifty years he’d demanded.

relations.relation: 夫妻（同时是夜帝国君与后，政治上从属）
relations.quote: “How am I to hold on to my authority if I am seen to let my wife flout it at every turn? We are not in the Nenavar Dominion anymore, Lachis’ka.”

relations.relation: 父子（父亲先在马哈吉尔憩地设据点）
relations.quote: “Mahagir’s Rest is no longer inviolate,” said Alaric. “My father already installed a base there.

relations.relation: 统治者与被统治者（他自称无须征询已归顺者）
relations.quote: I don’t need to ask anyone, least of all those who have submitted to my reign.

relations.b: 议会议员（阿拉里克的僚属）
relations.relation: 敌对/被孤立（她当众被要求闭嘴，议员们见证）
relations.quote: You appeared to care an awful lot about your lackeys’ approval when you basically told me to shut up in front of the entire council.

relations.relation: 君臣誓约（加冕时她宣誓服从他的意志）
relations.quote: Those same lackeys were present at the coronation when you swore your obedience to my will

numbers.context: 阿拉里克讥讽她已厌倦丈夫，说这不利两人往后五十年
numbers.quote: “Tired of your husband already?” Alaric drawled. “That doesn’t bode well for the next fifty years.”

numbers.context: 塔拉辛回敬：再多给他五十秒都算他走运
numbers.quote: “You’d be lucky if I gave you fifty more seconds,” Talasyn bit out.

numbers.context: 阿拉里克要她再给他五十年，说绝不放手
numbers.quote: “Because you will give me fifty more years, Talasyn.” Every word felt like it was being wrenched out of him from the same place where his magic lay.

numbers.context: 他为那些法案已筹划了数月
numbers.quote: questioning prospective laws that I have spent months working on
